# Orb

> Orb is a conversational execution platform by D'Arch Systems. It gives an organization's team a single natural-language interface to run SAP Business One processes (checking stock, creating and approving purchase requests, generating invoices) without menus, transaction codes or waiting on a specialist. Every action is reviewed and confirmed before it runs, and every conversation is logged.

SAP Business One is the system Orb connects to today. More systems are planned, and they are onboarded through configuration rather than code, using the Model Context Protocol (MCP).

Orb is a multi-tenant web application: each organization has its own isolated workspace. Users sign in through SAP's identity provider (OAuth2 / OpenID Connect) or with their SAP Business One credentials, and organizations that do not have a workspace yet can request one from the home page. The interface and Orb's replies are available in English and Spanish.

What Orb does:

- Natural-language operations on SAP Business One: stock checks, purchase requisitions, approvals, invoices and vendor lookups.
- Batch processing from chat or from files: one transaction per record, with a summary of what succeeded and what failed.
- File content extraction from CSV, Excel, ODS, PDF, HTML, JSON, RTF and plain text, to answer questions or pre-fill forms.
- Intention Graph: interrupted tasks are paused and resumed automatically.
- Projects to group related chats, and a File Bucket for uploaded and Orb-generated documents.
- A usage dashboard for organization admins, measured against seat and token limits.

Security: Orb runs in an isolated private network on AWS infrastructure certified against SOC 1 Type II, SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001/27017/27018. Conversations, sessions and configuration are encrypted at rest and in transit. Connecting Orb to SAP Business One never requires opening a customer's network to the internet (VPN, Direct Connect, PrivateLink or VPC Peering).
